en: Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling, a state that is a root-cause and associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*).

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling, a state that is not a root-cause and associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling... [and so forth].

Dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling that is a root-cause, there arise states associated with pleasant feeling that are both root-causes and not root-causes, by way of the root-condition.

(Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three. For the "not-root" [condition] based on the "not-associated-with-painful-feeling" root, there are likewise only three.
(Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three. (There is no resultant.)

Dependent on a state that is not a root and is not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is a root and is associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there are three.
